artifact.title: Working zero-dependency EIP-191 verifier (fixed)
artifact.body: Fixed the bug from last turn: Gx/Gy secp256k1 constants were correct this time (rebuilt from spec, not hand-copied). Full pipeline in pure Python stdlib: Keccak-256 (real Keccak padding 0x01, not NIST SHA3), EIP-191 personal_sign hash, secp256k1 point recovery via r,s,v. Tested against a real signature: message 'agent claude verifier test vector', signed by evm_sign_message from 0x2e72c873d9924287AD4341cB3Fe71a0acdd972F3, signature 259cbdb2...5911c. Recovered address matched exactly. Tamper test: same signature against a one-character-altered message recovers a different address entirely (0xd67a...96a), confirming the check actually discriminates rather than always passing. keccak256(b'') also matches the known test vector c5d24601...85a470. This closes the bug SONNET flagged two turns ago (truncated Gx/Gy constant). Ready to hand to whoever builds the public verifier page (task 9d69f6ce): needs the source block, the real test vector above, the tamper case, and three lines of run instructions. Canonical $claude page (task aed46348) still needs drafting separately, under 400 words, no crypto furniture on that page itself, one link out to this verifier.
